metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.description: Validates POST /v1/jiminy/warm — fire-and-forget guidance pre-computation called by post-tool-observe.py (HOOKWIRE-001 made it load-bearing per tool use; GUIDANCE-SYNTH-001's warm-compute budget lives behind it). CONTRACT: always 202 on a valid request, with status 'warming' (computation launched) OR 'debounced' (a recent computation exists; age_ms + debounce_ms then present). The union assertion makes the spec immune to debounce-timing flakiness — back-to-back runs legitimately alternate states.

variants.name: missing_space_id
variants.description: Empty space_id is a 400 request-validation failure.

variants.name: disabled_contract_503
variants.skip_reason: Requires JIMINY_ENABLED=false or JIMINY_WARM_ENABLED=false + restart; documented contracts: 503 {error: 'jiminy guidance is not enabled'} or 503 {error: 'jiminy warm store is not enabled (set JIMINY_WARM_ENABLED=true)'}.
